pages.text: Addendum for $(l:structures/alteration_site)$(c)$(o)Alteration Sites$().$(br)$(br)These little freaks infuriate me to no end sometimes. At first I thought of them as somewhat 'cute' but I quickly realized their true nature. They pop out from the ground wherever there is just a little remnant of the plague and rush toward me to relieve me of the object I am holding. They have ruined many a tests by stealing a crucial object that I was using, and leaving me with only my own wits.

One such example was when they took my sword as I was dealing with some Weavers. It was an unpleasant experience. Since then I learned that holding Organic Matter causes them to behave weirdly and because of this I make sure I always have some on me. They follow with haste whoever they stole it from until the victim takes it back, all the while behaving rather docile. I do admit, when they act like this, they can be rather adorable...
Another thing to note is that from what I observed, some Holders are made up of pure GREED, to the point they will even steal from monsters. It can be quite entertaining to watch!
